name: flask_calculator_deployment_v2
description: Full lifecycle development and deployment of a web-based calculator service.
objective: Deliver a fully functional, containerized calculator application with a web interface. The solution must be verified for accuracy and stability before being authorized for production deployment.

members.responsibilities:
Develop a calculator service with the following capabilities:
- A web-based user interface and a functional API supporting basic arithmetic.
- All necessary environment configurations and containerization files required for deployment.
- Documentation covering local setup and service operations.
- Preliminary validation to ensure the build is stable for the testing phase.

Conduct a comprehensive quality assurance audit of the developed application:
- Validate that all arithmetic operations return correct results and handle edge cases.
- Verify the integrity of the application routes and user interface.
- Document the results in a 'REVIEW_VERDICT.md' file, explicitly stating 'PASS' or 'FAIL' on the first line based on the success of the test suite.

Act as the final authority on project quality and deployment readiness:
- Audit the source code, container configuration, and test reports for compliance with project objectives.
- Provide a 'FINAL_REVIEW.md' with a clear 'APPROVED' or 'REJECTED' status.
- Upon approval, issue the deployment authorization using the required system protocol string: DEPLOYMENT_REQUEST:flask-calculator:5000:python3 app.py

ceremonies.name: Technical Handoff
ceremonies.description: Summarize the developer's deliverables for the testing team.

ceremonies.name: Quality Review Gate
ceremonies.description: Assess testing outcomes. Failures require a rework cycle; successes move to final review.

ceremonies.name: Project Consolidation
ceremonies.description: Collate all project artifacts and reports for the final audit.

ceremonies.name: Deployment Gate
ceremonies.description: Final validation of deployment readiness and authorization.
